macOS için League of Legends yardımcısı:: A League of Legends companion for macOS: champion select suggestions, rune pages, skill order, item and augment tips.
Galio oyuna asla tuş basmaz veya tıklama: Galio never presses keys or clicks in the game, never reads game memory, and never shows hidden information or other players' stats.
